params.1273: Take a rest by a musician.
params.1274: Running drains your run energy. When your energy is used up, you cannot run until it returns.
params.1275: You can restore run energy by walking, by resting on the ground, or by resting by a musician.
params.1276: Resting will double your restore rate; resting by a musician will triple it.
params.1277: To rest by a musician, right-click on him or her and choose Listen-to.
params.1278: To stop listening, simply walk (or run!) away.
params.1279: There are musicians to be found throughout the world - look for a musical note icon on your map.
